# York Region Web Studio

> Custom websites for small businesses in York Region and the Greater Toronto Area — designed, built, hosted and looked after by our studio in Aurora, Ontario. We also handle bookkeeping and payroll prep, and set up Foxuma, our work hub for shops and trades.

## About
York Region Web Studio is a one-stop tech studio in Aurora, Ontario. We build premium custom websites for local businesses and look after them after launch — hosting, domain, updates, backups and small changes are handled by us. Your domain, content and data are yours, stored in Canada, and we sign an NDA with every client.

## Services
- Websites: custom design and build, from $899 — every site is quoted in writing after a short call, and most launch in two to four weeks once we have your content
- Bookkeeping & Payroll: monthly books and payroll prep for trades and small businesses on QuickBooks Online, in English or 普通话 — bank feed posted and categorized, receipts digitized and filed, pay runs prepped, HST-ready records. Plans from $99/month ($99–$199)
- Growth Package: reviews and quote follow-up handled for local businesses (see the site for the current package)
- For millwork and cabinet shops: Foxuma setup and training, a branded estimator on your own site, and remote estimating — built in a working shop, from $99/month
- Foxuma: our all-in-one work hub — leads, jobs, production, schedules, team chat, invoicing and payroll hours in one system. Foxuma's own plans start at $99/month, listed at foxuma.com; studio setup is priced in your written quote

## Service area
York Region and the GTA: Aurora, Newmarket, Richmond Hill, Vaughan, Markham and surrounding areas.

## Our work
- Flagship build: the Newood Millwork Inc. corporate website — https://newoodmillwork.com
